Set up my group on this phone

Dholuo_draft: Los riwruok mara e simu ni

english: Pick one — you can always add more accounts later.
kiswahili_for_reference: Chagua moja — unaweza kuongeza akaunti nyingine baadaye.
Dholuo_draft: Yier achiel — inyalo medo mamoko bangʼe.

english: This phone will keep our group's savings, loans and meetings.
kiswahili_for_reference: Simu hii itatunza akiba, mikopo na mikutano ya kikundi chetu.

english: I want to see my own savings, shares and loans.
kiswahili_for_reference: Nataka kuona akiba, hisa na mikopo yangu.

kiswahili_for_reference: Wakala wa Kijiji au CBT — nasaidia na kufuatilia vikundi kadhaa.
Dholuo_draft: Jakony mar Gwengʼ kata CBT — akonyo kendo aneno riwruoge mangʼeny.

english: At least 6 characters — keep it secret.
Dholuo_draft: Nyaka bed gi otonge 6 kata mokalo — kane opondo.

english: Creating an account needs an internet connection. Your phone number is your sign-in.
kiswahili_for_reference: Kufungua akaunti kunahitaji intaneti. Nambari yako ya simu ndiyo utakayotumia kuingia.
Dholuo_draft: Loso akaunt dwaro intanet. Namba mar simu mari ema ikonyorego donjo.

english: Sign in with your phone number and password.
kiswahili_for_reference: Ingia kwa nambari yako ya simu na nenosiri.
Dholuo_draft: Donji gi namba mar simu mari kod wach mopondo.

kiswahili_for_reference: Nambari ya simu au barua pepe
Dholuo_draft: Namba mar simu kata baruwa mar intanet

english: Your session lasts 8 hours. The group's record book keeps working offline once you are signed in.
kiswahili_for_reference: Kipindi chako hudumu saa 8; daftari la nje ya mtandao huendelea kufanya kazi bila kuingia tena.

kiswahili_for_reference: Akiba, mikopo na siku za mikutano
Dholuo_draft: Pesa mokan, hola kod odiechienge mag chokruok

english: Let members get their own sign-in to see their savings
kiswahili_for_reference: Ruhusu wanachama wapate akaunti zao kuona akiba zao
Dholuo_draft: Yie mondo jomembe oyud akaunt mag-gi mondo one pesa mag-gi

english: Money, members and meetings — share text or PDF
kiswahili_for_reference: Pesa, wanachama na mikutano — tuma maandishi au PDF
Dholuo_draft: Pesa, jomembe kod chokruoge — or ndiko kata PDF

english: A statement for each member — share text or PDF

english: Choose the language for this phone
Every screen is translated, but a speaker of this language has not checked the wording yet. If something reads wrongly, please tell us — you can switch back to English or Kiswahili at any time.
kiswahili_for_reference: Kila skrini imetafsiriwa, lakini mzungumzaji wa lugha hii bado hajakagua maneno. Kama kitu hakisomeki vizuri, tuambie — unaweza kurudi kwa Kiingereza au Kiswahili wakati wowote.
Dholuo_draft: Kama ineno duto oselok, to ngʼat mawacho dhokni pok onono weche. Ka gimoro ok somre maber, nyiswa — inyalo dok e Kingereza kata Kiswahili sa asaya.

english: Your group's savings, loans and meetings stay saved on this phone, but nobody can open them until you sign in again. Your phone number will be remembered.
kiswahili_for_reference: Akiba, mikopo na mikutano ya kikundi chenu vitabaki vimehifadhiwa kwenye simu hii, lakini hakuna atakayeweza kuvifungua hadi uingie tena. Nambari yako ya simu itakumbukwa.

english: You will need to sign in again to see your savings. Your phone number will be remembered.
kiswahili_for_reference: Utahitaji kuingia tena ili kuona akiba yako. Nambari yako ya simu itakumbukwa.
Dholuo_draft: Ibiro dwaro donjo kendo mondo ine pesa mokan magi. Namba mar simu mari ibiro par.

english: You will need to sign in again to see your groups. Your phone number will be remembered.
kiswahili_for_reference: Utahitaji kuingia tena ili kuona vikundi vyako. Nambari yako ya simu itakumbukwa.
Dholuo_draft: Ibiro dwaro donjo kendo mondo ine riwruoge magi. Namba mar simu mari ibiro par.

english: Choose the kind of account you use, then enter your phone number and password.
kiswahili_for_reference: Chagua aina ya akaunti unayotumia, kisha weka nambari yako ya simu na nenosiri.
Dholuo_draft: Yier kit akaunt mitiyogo, eka iket namba mar simu mari kod wach mopondo.

english: Could not load the welfare fund.
Dholuo_draft: Sanduk mar kony ok nyal yudore.

Loro loro ndiko duto nyaka chiengʼ.

english: Add the members joining this cycle. You can always add more later.
kiswahili_for_reference: Ongeza wanachama wanaojiunga na mzunguko huu. Unaweza kuongeza wengine baadaye.

english: Which savings cycle is this group on?

english: Everyone present votes once. Nobody can vote twice.
kiswahili_for_reference: Kila aliyepo hupiga kura mara moja. Hakuna anayeweza kupiga mara mbili.
Dholuo_draft: Ngʼato ka ngʼato manie kanyo yiero dichiel. Onge ngʼama nyalo yiero didiriyo.

english: Should we buy a group water tank?

english: Leave a box empty to keep what is already saved.
kiswahili_for_reference: Acha kisanduku wazi ili kubaki na kilichohifadhiwa.
Dholuo_draft: We sanduk nono mondo ikan gima osekan.

english: Loan offers from lending partners — apply as a group.
kiswahili_for_reference: Mikopo kutoka kwa washirika wa kukopesha — omba kama kikundi.

Onge gik moko e kit ni

english: Try a different category or check back later.

Pesa mokan maga e riwruoge duto

Dholuo_draft: Pod ok in e riwruok moro

kiswahili_for_reference: Rekodi za akiba na mikopo yako zitaonekana hapa.

english: No members loaded for this group yet.
kiswahili_for_reference: Hakuna wanachama waliopakiwa kwa kikundi hiki bado.

kiswahili_for_reference: Bei ya amana ya kawaida — kiwango hakipatikani.
Dholuo_draft: Nengo mar chudo mokwongo machalre — pim ok yudre.

Close cycle and start the next

kiswahili_for_reference: Kusoma tu — bado inaonekana kwenye ripoti
Dholuo_draft: Somo kende — pod nenore e ripot

What they run together, and how it is doing.

kiswahili_for_reference: Huhifadhiwa kwenye simu hii kwanza, kisha hutumwa ukipata mtandao.
Dholuo_draft: Ikane e simu ni mokwongo, eka oor ka iyudo mtandao.

english: No SMS? Use my saved PIN instead
kiswahili_for_reference: Hakuna SMS? Tumia PIN yangu iliyohifadhiwa

kiswahili_for_reference: Ingia kwenye akaunti yako ili kuona na kushiriki ripoti yako.

english: or use a group access key
Dholuo_draft: kata ti gi rayaw mar riwruok

Set up your group first, then come back for a report.
kiswahili_for_reference: Sajili kikundi chako kwanza, kisha urudi kwa ripoti.
Dholuo_draft: Los riwruok mari mokwongo, eka iduogi ne ripot.

english: Members appear here once they join the group.
kiswahili_for_reference: Wanachama huonekana hapa wanapojiunga na kikundi.
Dholuo_draft: Jomembe nenore ka bangʼ donjo e riwruok.

kiswahili_for_reference: Mwanachama huyu hayupo tena kwenye kikundi.

english: Loans this member takes will appear here.
kiswahili_for_reference: Mikopo atakayochukua mwanachama huyu itaonekana hapa.
Dholuo_draft: Hola ma jamembeni biro kawo nonenre ka.

english: e.g. Buying maize seed for the season
kiswahili_for_reference: mfano: kununua mbegu za mahindi kwa msimu
Dholuo_draft: kaka: ngʼiewo kodhi mar oduma mar ndalo mar pur

english: No outstanding loans — nothing to repay. 🎉
kiswahili_for_reference: Hakuna mkopo unaodaiwa — hakuna cha kurejesha. 🎉
Dholuo_draft: Onge hola modongʼ — onge gima ichulo. 🎉

english: Who is signed in, language, appearance and app details
kiswahili_for_reference: Aliyeingia, lugha, mwonekano na maelezo ya programu
Dholuo_draft: Ngʼama odonjo, dhok, kite monenore kod weche mag app

english: Once a group accepts you, your savings will show here.
kiswahili_for_reference: Kikundi kikikukubali, akiba yako itaonekana hapa.
Dholuo_draft: Ka riwruok orwaki, pesa mokan magi biro nenore ka.

english: This meeting is closed — the record is read-only.
kiswahili_for_reference: Mkutano huu umefungwa — rekodi ni ya kusoma tu.
Dholuo_draft: Chokruokni olor — ndiko gin mag somo kende.

english: Add members to the group first.
Use the web console for this account
Load your group onto this phone
kiswahili_for_reference: Pakia kikundi chako kwenye simu hii
Dholuo_draft: Kel riwruok mari e simu ni

english: Tap a member to see and share their report.
kiswahili_for_reference: Gusa mwanachama ili kuona na kushiriki ripoti yake.
Dholuo_draft: Mul jamembe mondo ine kendo ipog ripot mare.

english: This group has no open actions from previous visits.
kiswahili_for_reference: Kikundi hiki hakina kazi zilizobaki kutoka ziara zilizopita.
Dholuo_draft: Riwruokni onge gi tije modongʼ moa e limbe mokalo.

english: Choose how Intelli-Cash looks on this phone.
kiswahili_for_reference: Chagua jinsi Intelli-Cash inavyoonekana kwenye simu hii.
Dholuo_draft: Yier kaka Intelli-Cash nenore e simu ni.

english: When groups are assigned to you, they appear here with their credit rating.
kiswahili_for_reference: Vikundi vikikabidhiwa kwako, vitaonekana hapa pamoja na kiwango chao cha mkopo.
Dholuo_draft: Ka riwruoge omiyi, ginenore ka kaachiel gi pim mar hola mag-gi.

english: The savings curve appears after your first two meetings.
kiswahili_for_reference: Mchoro wa akiba huonekana baada ya mikutano yako miwili ya kwanza.
Dholuo_draft: Kido mar pesa mokan nenore bangʼ chokruoge ariyo mokwongo.

english: This member has no borrowing headroom — savings must grow or the current loan must reduce first.
kiswahili_for_reference: Mwanachama huyu hana nafasi ya kukopa — akiba lazima iongezeke au mkopo wa sasa upungue kwanza.
Dholuo_draft: Jamembeni onge gi thuolo mar holo — pesa mokan nyaka medre kata hola ma en-go nyaka dok piny mokwongo.

english: The loan fund is empty. Collect share purchases or loan repayments before lending again.
kiswahili_for_reference: Mfuko wa mikopo ni tupu. Kusanya ununuzi wa hisa au marejesho ya mikopo kabla ya kukopesha tena.
Dholuo_draft: Sanduk mar hola onge gimoro. Chok ngʼiewo mar hisa kata chulo mar hola kapok ichako holo kendo.

english: Repayments are recorded inside meetings and appear here instantly.
kiswahili_for_reference: Marejesho hurekodiwa ndani ya mikutano na huonekana hapa mara moja.
Dholuo_draft: Chulo indiko e chokruoge kendo nenore ka gisano.

english: Loans are disbursed inside a meeting — open a meeting and use Disburse Loan.
kiswahili_for_reference: Mikopo hutolewa ndani ya mkutano — fungua mkutano kisha tumia Toa Mkopo.
Dholuo_draft: Hola ichiwo e chokruok — yaw chokruok eka iti gi Chiw Hola.

english: Request sent. Ask the member to enter their M-Pesa PIN on their phone.
kiswahili_for_reference: Ombi limetumwa. Mwambie mwanachama aweke PIN yake ya M-Pesa kwenye simu yake.
Dholuo_draft: Kwayo oor. Kwa jamembe mondo oket PIN mare mar M-Pesa e simu mare.

english: This meeting is closed. Its records are read-only and form part of the audit trail.
kiswahili_for_reference: Mkutano huu umefungwa. Rekodi zake ni za kusoma tu na ni sehemu ya kumbukumbu za ukaguzi.
Dholuo_draft: Chokruokni olor. Ndiko mage gin mag somo kende kendo gin achiel kuom nonro.

english: All records in this meeting will be locked permanently. This cannot be undone.
kiswahili_for_reference: Rekodi zote za mkutano huu zitafungwa milele. Hili haliwezi kutenguliwa.
Dholuo_draft: Ndiko duto mag chokruokni ibiro lor nyaka chiengʼ. Ma ok nyal lokre.

english: 3-key unlock is on: officials confirm their PINs before the meeting opens.
kiswahili_for_reference: Funguo 3 zimewashwa: viongozi huthibitisha PIN zao kabla mkutano kufunguliwa.
Dholuo_draft: Rayaw 3 tiyo: jotelo guro PIN mag-gi kapok chokruok oyaw.

english: Start your first meeting to record attendance, savings, fines and loans.
kiswahili_for_reference: Anzisha mkutano wako wa kwanza ili kurekodi mahudhurio, akiba, faini na mikopo.
Dholuo_draft: Chak chokruok mari mokwongo mondo indik bedo e chokruok, pesa mokan, chudo kod hola.

english: Closed meetings are locked — their records form the group\'s permanent audit trail.
kiswahili_for_reference: Mikutano iliyofungwa imefungwa — rekodi zake ni kumbukumbu za kudumu za kikundi.
Dholuo_draft: Chokruoge molor olor — ndiko mag-gi ema gin nonro mar riwruok manyaka chiengʼ.

english: Share purchases land here the moment they are recorded.
kiswahili_for_reference: Ununuzi wa hisa huonekana hapa mara tu unaporekodiwa.
Dholuo_draft: Ngʼiewo mar hisa nenore ka sano ka ondiki.

english: Your group has a code on its records — ask the secretary if you do not know it. Sending a request does not open the group\'s books to you; an official has to accept you first.
kiswahili_for_reference: Kikundi chako kina msimbo kwenye rekodi zake — muulize katibu kama hukijui. Kutuma ombi hakukufungulii vitabu vya kikundi; kiongozi lazima akukubali kwanza.
Dholuo_draft: Riwruok mari nigi rangʼiny e ndiko mage — penj jagoro ka ok ingʼeye. Oro kwayo ok yawni buge mag riwruok; jatelo nyaka rwaki mokwongo.

english: Ask your group to add you and your savings will show up here.
kiswahili_for_reference: Omba kikundi chako kikuongeze na akiba yako itaonekana hapa.
Dholuo_draft: Kwa riwruok mari mondo omedi eka pesa mokan magi nonenre ka.

english: Correcting a spelling or a mistyped number. Their savings, loans and attendance stay exactly as they are.
kiswahili_for_reference: Kurekebisha herufi au namba iliyokosewa. Akiba, mikopo na mahudhurio yao hubaki kama yalivyo.
Dholuo_draft: Loso otonge kata namba mane ondik marach. Pesa mokan, hola kod bedo e chokruok mage siko kaka gin.

english: They will not be added to the group. You can say why if you want to — it is not required.
kiswahili_for_reference: Hataongezwa kwenye kikundi. Unaweza kueleza sababu ukitaka — si lazima.
Dholuo_draft: Ok nomedi e riwruok. Inyalo wacho gimomiyo ka idwaro — ok ochuno.

english: This list is out of date. Pull down to refresh, then check the answer again.
kiswahili_for_reference: Orodha hii si ya sasa. Vuta chini ili kuonyesha upya, kisha angalia jibu tena.
Dholuo_draft: Chenroni ok en mar sani. Ywa piny mondo onwo, eka ine duoko kendo.

english: When someone asks to join your group, their request will show up here for you to answer.
kiswahili_for_reference: Mtu akiomba kujiunga na kikundi chako, ombi lake litaonekana hapa ili ulijibu.
Dholuo_draft: Ka ngʼato okwayo mondo odonji e riwruok mari, kwaye nonenre ka mondo iduok.

english: To create a sign-in account, first back this group up to the cloud (More → Sync & Backup) while online.
kiswahili_for_reference: Ili kutengeneza akaunti ya kuingia, kwanza hifadhi kikundi hiki kwenye wingu (Mangine → Sync & Backup) ukiwa mtandaoni.
Dholuo_draft: Mondo ilos akaunt mar donjo, mokwongo kan riwruokni e bor (Mamoko → Sync & Backup) ka in gi intanet.

english: Loans this member takes will be listed here with their live status.
kiswahili_for_reference: Mikopo atakayochukua mwanachama huyu itaorodheshwa hapa na hali yake ya sasa.
Dholuo_draft: Hola ma jamembeni biro kawo ibiro ndiki ka kaachiel gi kaka gichalo sani.

english: Add members with the button below — each gets an individual savings and loan profile.
kiswahili_for_reference: Ongeza wanachama kwa kitufe kilicho chini — kila mmoja hupata rekodi yake ya akiba na mikopo.
Dholuo_draft: Med jomembe gi rayaw manie piny — ngʼato ka ngʼato yudo ndiko mare owuon mar pesa mokan kod hola.

english: Assign a chairperson, secretary and treasurer below so three officials can unlock meetings. Until then, most members\' PINs are needed instead.
kiswahili_for_reference: Teua mwenyekiti, katibu na mweka hazina hapa chini ili viongozi watatu waweze kufungua mikutano. Hadi hapo, PIN za wanachama wengi ndizo zitahitajika.
Dholuo_draft: Yier jakom, jagoro kod jakeno e piny mondo jotelo adek onyal yawo chokruoge. Kapok mano, PIN mag jomembe mangʼeny ema dwarore.

english: The old PIN stops working. The member chooses a new PIN the next time they turn their key at a meeting unlock.
kiswahili_for_reference: PIN ya zamani huacha kufanya kazi. Mwanachama huchagua PIN mpya wakati mwingine atakapotumia ufunguo wake kufungua mkutano.
Dholuo_draft: PIN machon weyo tiyo. Jamembe yiero PIN manyien kinde machielo ma otiyo gi rayaw mare e yawo chokruok.

kiswahili_for_reference:
Akiba na mikopo ya kikundi chako, hapo hapo kwenye simu yako. Kila kitu huhifadhiwa kwenye simu hii kwanza, kisha hufanyiwa nakala mtandaoni ukipata intaneti.

Intelli-Wealth Limited · intelliwealth.org

Pesa mokan kod hola mag riwruok mari, e simu mari. Gimoro amora ikano e simu ni mokwongo, eka okan e intanet ka iyudo mtandao.

Intelli-Wealth Limited · intelliwealth.org

english: No internet — your records are safe on this phone and will back up later.
kiswahili_for_reference: Hakuna intaneti — rekodi zako ziko salama kwenye simu hii na zitahifadhiwa baadaye.
Dholuo_draft: Onge intanet — ndiko magi ni maber e simu ni kendo ibiro kan bangʼe.

english: The phone app is for groups, members and field agents. Your account does not need to create a group here — sign in on the web console instead, or sign out to use a different account.
kiswahili_for_reference: Programu ya simu ni ya vikundi, wanachama na maafisa wa uwandani. Akaunti yako haihitaji kuunda kikundi hapa — ingia kwenye tovuti badala yake, au toka ili kutumia akaunti nyingine.
Dholuo_draft: App mar simu en mar riwruoge, jomembe kod jokony mag gwengʼ. Akaunt mari ok dwar loso riwruok ka — donji e intanet kar mano, kata wuog mondo iti gi akaunt machielo.

english: Your group is already on the server. Load it here instead of creating a new one, so your savings history stays in one record.
kiswahili_for_reference: Kikundi chako tayari kiko kwenye seva. Kipakie hapa badala ya kuunda kipya, ili historia ya akiba yako ibaki rekodi moja.
Dholuo_draft: Riwruok mari nitie e seva. Kele ka kar loso manyien, mondo weche mag pesa mokan magi osik e ndiko achiel.

english: When groups are assigned to you, their report appears here.
kiswahili_for_reference: Vikundi vikikabidhiwa kwako, ripoti yake itaonekana hapa.
Dholuo_draft: Ka riwruoge omiyi, ripot mag-gi nenore ka.

english: Figures from this phone only - work saved on other phones may not be included yet.
kiswahili_for_reference: Takwimu za simu hii pekee - kazi iliyohifadhiwa kwenye simu nyingine huenda bado haijajumuishwa.
Dholuo_draft: Namba moa e simu ni kende - tich mokan e simu mamoko nyalo bedo ni pod ok oriw.

english: From this phone only. Work saved on other phones may not be included yet.
kiswahili_for_reference: Kutoka simu hii pekee. Kazi iliyohifadhiwa kwenye simu nyingine huenda bado haijajumuishwa.
Dholuo_draft: Koa e simu ni kende. Tich mokan e simu mamoko nyalo bedo ni pod ok oriw.

english: Figures from this phone only - records saved elsewhere may not be included yet.
kiswahili_for_reference: Takwimu za simu hii pekee - rekodi zilizohifadhiwa kwingine huenda bado hazijajumuishwa.
Dholuo_draft: Namba moa e simu ni kende - ndiko mokan kamoro machielo nyalo bedo ni pod ok oriw.

english: What you owe is counted for each group on its own. Paying extra in one group does not reduce what you owe in another.
kiswahili_for_reference: Deni lako huhesabiwa kwa kila kikundi peke yake. Kulipa zaidi katika kikundi kimoja hakupunguzi deni lako katika kingine.
Dholuo_draft: Gopi ikwano ne riwruok ka riwruok kende. Chulo mangʼeny e riwruok achiel ok dwok piny gopi e riwruok machielo.

english: This clears the local↔backend mapping. Already-synced records stay on the server; nothing is deleted.
kiswahili_for_reference: Hii huondoa uhusiano kati ya simu na seva. Rekodi zilizokwisha sawazishwa hubaki kwenye seva; hakuna kinachofutwa.
Dholuo_draft: Ma golo tudruok manie kind simu kod seva. Ndiko moseriw siko e seva; onge gima iruchi.

english: Connect to the IntelliCash backend before linking and syncing this group.
kiswahili_for_reference: Unganisha kwenye seva ya IntelliCash kabla ya kuunganisha na kusawazisha kikundi hiki.
Dholuo_draft: Tud gi seva mar IntelliCash kapok itudo kendo iriwo riwruokni.

english: Linking matches your local members to the backend roster by phone, then name. Unmatched members can be linked by hand afterwards.
kiswahili_for_reference: Kuunganisha hulinganisha wanachama wa simu hii na orodha ya seva kwa namba ya simu, kisha kwa jina. Wasiolingana wanaweza kuunganishwa kwa mkono baadaye.
Dholuo_draft: Tudruok romo jomembe mag simu ni gi chenro mar seva kokalo kuom namba mar simu, eka kuom nying. Joma ok oromo inyalo tudo gi lwedo bangʼe.

english: These local members have no backend match. Link them before their transactions can sync.
kiswahili_for_reference: Wanachama hawa wa simu hii hawana wenzao kwenye seva. Waunganishe kabla miamala yao haijaweza kusawazishwa.
Dholuo_draft: Jomembe mag simu ni onge gi joma romogo e seva. Tudgi kapok weche mag-gi nyalo riwore.

english: Uploads attendance and ledger (shares, social fund, loans, repayments) for every closed meeting. Safe to re-run — already synced records are skipped. Fines and meeting sealing come in a later phase.
kiswahili_for_reference: Hupakia mahudhurio na daftari (hisa, mfuko wa jamii, mikopo, marejesho) kwa kila mkutano uliofungwa. Ni salama kurudia — rekodi zilizokwisha sawazishwa huachwa. Faini na kufunga mikutano huja katika hatua ijayo.
Dholuo_draft: Oro bedo e chokruok kod bug weche (hisa, sanduk mar kony, hola, chulo) mar chokruok ka chokruok molor. Ber nwoyo — ndiko moseriw ikalo. Chudo kod loro chokruoge biro bangʼe.

english: Ask your group administrator for an access key, then paste it here. It only lets this phone see and record your group\'s savings, loans and meetings.
kiswahili_for_reference: Omba msimamizi wa kikundi chako ufunguo wa kuingia, kisha ubandike hapa. Unaruhusu simu hii kuona na kurekodi akiba, mikopo na mikutano ya kikundi chako tu.
Dholuo_draft: Kwa jarit mar riwruok mari rayaw, eka iket ka. Oyie mana simu ni mondo one kendo ondik pesa mokan, hola kod chokruoge mag riwruok mari.

english: Pull down to try again. If it keeps happening, check the group is still selected under Cloud Account.
kiswahili_for_reference: Vuta chini ujaribu tena. Ikiendelea, hakikisha kikundi bado kimechaguliwa chini ya Akaunti ya Wingu.
Dholuo_draft: Ywa piny item kendo. Ka omedo timore, ne ka riwruok pod oyier e bwo Akaunt mar Bor.

english: Closing a cycle makes its records read-only. Nothing is deleted — past meetings and money stay in history and reports.
kiswahili_for_reference: Kufunga mzunguko hufanya rekodi zake ziwe za kusoma tu. Hakuna kinachofutwa — mikutano na fedha zilizopita hubaki kwenye historia na ripoti.
Dholuo_draft: Loro ndalo miyo ndiko mage bedo mag somo kende. Onge gima iruchi — chokruoge kod pesa mokalo siko e weche machon kod ripot.

english: You can see the cycles but not close one. Only the group account or a platform admin can.
kiswahili_for_reference: Unaweza kuona mizunguko lakini huwezi kufunga. Ni akaunti ya kikundi au msimamizi wa jukwaa pekee anayeweza.
Dholuo_draft: Inyalo neno ndalo to ok inyal loro. Mana akaunt mar riwruok kata jarit mar platform ema nyalo.

english: Applies to new loans. Loans already given keep the term they were agreed with — changing this never changes what a member already owes.
kiswahili_for_reference: Hutumika kwa mikopo mipya. Mikopo iliyokwisha tolewa hubaki na muda iliokubaliwa — kubadilisha hili hakubadilishi deni la mwanachama.
Dholuo_draft: Tiyo ne hola manyien. Hola mosechiw siko gi kinde mane oyiego — loko ma ok lok gima jamembe osegopo.

english: Flat on the amount borrowed each month — it does not fall as the member repays, and it stops at the end of the agreed term. Zero is fine: many groups lend interest-free. Each loan keeps the rate it was made at, so changing this never reprices money already lent.
kiswahili_for_reference: Ni kiwango kimoja juu ya kiasi kilichokopwa kila mwezi — hakipungui mwanachama anapolipa, na huisha mwisho wa muda uliokubaliwa. Sifuri ni sawa: vikundi vingi hukopesha bila riba. Kila mkopo hubaki na riba uliotolewa nayo, kwa hivyo kubadilisha hili hakubadilishi fedha zilizokwisha kopeshwa.
Dholuo_draft: En pim achiel kuom pesa mane oholo dwe ka dwe — ok odok piny ka jamembe chulo, kendo orumo e giko mar kinde mane oyiego. Nono ber: riwruoge mangʼeny holo maonge ohala. Hola ka hola siko gi ohala mane ochiwego, omiyo loko ma ok lok pesa moseholi.

english: You can see these rules but not change them. Only the group account or a platform admin can.
kiswahili_for_reference: Unaweza kuona sheria hizi lakini huwezi kuzibadilisha. Ni akaunti ya kikundi au msimamizi wa jukwaa pekee anayeweza.
Dholuo_draft: Inyalo neno chikegi to ok inyal lokogi. Mana akaunt mar riwruok kata jarit mar platform ema nyalo.

english: Unpaid fines and welfare are taken off a member\'s share-out payout — they never stop a member from sharing out.\n\nOutstanding loans are taken off at share-out and are never carried into the next cycle.
kiswahili_for_reference:
Faini na michango ya jamii ambayo haijalipwa hukatwa kwenye mgao wa mwanachama — kamwe hazimzuii mwanachama kushiriki mgao.

Mikopo ambayo haijalipwa hukatwa wakati wa mgao na kamwe haipelekwi mzunguko unaofuata.
Dholuo_draft:
Chudo kod kony ma ok ochul igolo e pok mar jamembe — ok gigengʼ jamembe kuom yudo pok.

Hola ma ok ochul igolo e sa mar pogruok kendo ok ter e ndalo machielo.

english: M-Pesa Classic needs nothing here — the member types in the transaction code from their phone.
kiswahili_for_reference: M-Pesa Classic haihitaji chochote hapa — mwanachama huandika msimbo wa muamala kutoka simu yake.
Dholuo_draft: M-Pesa Classic ok dwar gimoro ka — jamembe ema ndiko rangʼiny mar wach koa e simu mare.

english: You can see this but not change it. Only the group account or a platform admin can move where money is received.
kiswahili_for_reference: Unaweza kuona hili lakini huwezi kulibadilisha. Ni akaunti ya kikundi au msimamizi wa jukwaa pekee anayeweza kuhamisha mahali fedha zinapopokelewa.
Dholuo_draft: Inyalo neno ma to ok inyal loke. Mana akaunt mar riwruok kata jarit mar platform ema nyalo loko kama pesa yudore.

english: You are offline. Welfare payments are recorded on the server so the fund cannot be overspent by two phones at once — reconnect to record one.
kiswahili_for_reference: Huna mtandao. Malipo ya jamii hurekodiwa kwenye seva ili mfuko usitumike kupita kiasi na simu mbili kwa wakati mmoja — unganisha ili kurekodi.
Dholuo_draft: Ionge e mtandao. Chudo mar kony indiko e seva mondo sanduk kik ti mokalo gi simu ariyo sa achiel — tud kendo mondo indik.

english: No meeting is open. Welfare is paid out during a meeting, in front of the members — open one first, then record it there.
kiswahili_for_reference: Hakuna mkutano ulio wazi. Fedha za jamii hulipwa wakati wa mkutano, mbele ya wanachama — fungua mkutano kwanza, kisha rekodi hapo.
Dholuo_draft: Onge chokruok moyaw. Pesa mar kony ichulo e sa mar chokruok, e nyim jomembe — yaw chokruok mokwongo, eka indik kanyo.

english: Members haven\'t bought shares this cycle. Run meetings and collect shares first, then come back to distribute the fund.
kiswahili_for_reference: Wanachama hawajanunua hisa mzunguko huu. Endesha mikutano na kusanya hisa kwanza, kisha urudi kugawanya mfuko.
Dholuo_draft: Jomembe pok ongʼiewo hisa e ndaloni. Ti chokruoge kendo ichok hisa mokwongo, eka iduogi mondo ipog pesa.

english: Credit rating unavailable — the lender checks it when reviewing your application.
kiswahili_for_reference: Kiwango cha mkopo hakipatikani — mkopeshaji hukiangalia anapopitia ombi lako.
Dholuo_draft: Pim mar hola ok yudre — ngʼat maholo ema nene ka onono kwayo mari.

english: Check back later — partners add new loan offers from time to time.
kiswahili_for_reference: Rudi baadaye — washirika huongeza mikopo mipya mara kwa mara.
Dholuo_draft: Duogi bangʼe — joma wariwore kodgi medo hola manyien kinde ka kinde.

english: External loans load from the Intelli-Cash backend. Connect or sign in first.
kiswahili_for_reference: Mikopo ya nje hupakiwa kutoka seva ya Intelli-Cash. Unganisha au ingia kwanza.
Dholuo_draft: Hola moa oko yudore koa e seva mar Intelli-Cash. Tud kata idonji mokwongo.

english: Farm, solar, household and business products — priced by your group\'s credit rating.
kiswahili_for_reference: Bidhaa za shamba, sola, nyumbani na biashara — bei kulingana na kiwango cha mkopo cha kikundi chako.
Dholuo_draft: Gik mag puodho, chiengʼ, ot kod ohala — nengo luwore gi pim mar hola mar riwruok mari.

english: Intelli-Stores loads from the Intelli-Cash backend. Connect or sign in first.
kiswahili_for_reference: Intelli-Stores hupakiwa kutoka seva ya Intelli-Cash. Unganisha au ingia kwanza.
Dholuo_draft: Intelli-Stores yudore koa e seva mar Intelli-Cash. Tud kata idonji mokwongo.

english: The group\'s own enterprise, not a member\'s. Leave blank if they do not run one.
kiswahili_for_reference: Biashara ya kikundi chenyewe, si ya mwanachama. Acha wazi kama hawana.
Dholuo_draft: Ohala mar riwruok owuon, ok mar jamembe. We nono ka gionge gi moro.

english: This visit has not synced yet, so the figures are saved against the group but not against this visit.
kiswahili_for_reference: Ziara hii bado haijasawazishwa, kwa hivyo takwimu zimehifadhiwa kwa kikundi lakini si kwa ziara hii.
Dholuo_draft: Limbeni pok oriwore, omiyo namba okan ne riwruok to ok ne limbeni.

english: Saved against this visit, so next time you can see what changed.
kiswahili_for_reference: Imehifadhiwa kwa ziara hii, ili wakati ujao uone kilichobadilika.
Dholuo_draft: Okan ne limbeni, mondo kinde machielo ine gima oselokore.

english: A visit can still be recorded without a location. Whether it matches this group is decided by the office, not here.
kiswahili_for_reference: Ziara bado inaweza kurekodiwa bila mahali. Kama inalingana na kikundi hiki huamuliwa na ofisi, si hapa.
Dholuo_draft: Limbe pod inyalo ndiki maonge kama otimore. Ka oromo gi riwruokni ingʼado e ofis, ok ka.

english: Record what you coached on, then let the group score it.
kiswahili_for_reference: Rekodi ulichofundisha, kisha waache kikundi kikipime.
Dholuo_draft: Ndik gima ne ipuonjo, eka iwe riwruok opime.

english: No assessment form has been downloaded yet. Connect once to fetch it, then it works offline.
kiswahili_for_reference: Hakuna fomu ya tathmini iliyopakuliwa bado. Unganisha mara moja ili kuipata, kisha itafanya kazi bila mtandao.
Dholuo_draft: Onge fom mar pim moseyudi. Tud dichiel mondo iyude, eka otiyo maonge mtandao.

english: Not scored yet. A visit can be recorded without it, but the group\'s view is the only useful measure of the coaching.
kiswahili_for_reference: Bado haijapimwa. Ziara inaweza kurekodiwa bila hii, lakini maoni ya kikundi ndiyo kipimo pekee muhimu cha ushauri.
Dholuo_draft: Pok opim. Limbe inyalo ndiki maonge ma, to paro mar riwruok ema en pim makende maber mar puonj.

english: No members loaded for this group yet. Connect and open the group first.
kiswahili_for_reference: Hakuna wanachama waliopakiwa kwa kikundi hiki bado. Unganisha na ufungue kikundi kwanza.
Dholuo_draft: Onge jomembe moyudi ne riwruokni pod. Tud kendo iyaw riwruok mokwongo.

english: Nobody sees who voted for what. The counts are still shown to everyone.
kiswahili_for_reference: Hakuna anayeona nani alipiga kura kwa nini. Idadi bado huonyeshwa kwa kila mtu.
Dholuo_draft: Onge ngʼama neno ngʼat mane oyiero ngʼa. Kwan pod inyiso ji duto.

english: No more votes can be cast after this, and the result is written into the group records. This cannot be undone.
kiswahili_for_reference: Hakuna kura zaidi zitakazopigwa baada ya hii, na matokeo huandikwa kwenye rekodi za kikundi. Hili haliwezi kutenguliwa.
Dholuo_draft: Onge yiero machielo manyalo timore bangʼ ma, kendo duoko indiko e ndiko mag riwruok. Ma ok nyal lokre.

english: Closing counts the votes and writes the result into the group records.
kiswahili_for_reference: Kufunga huhesabu kura na kuandika matokeo kwenye rekodi za kikundi.
Dholuo_draft: Loro kwano yiero kendo ndiko duoko e ndiko mag riwruok.

english: You have voted. This is a secret ballot, so your choice is not shown to anyone.
kiswahili_for_reference: Umepiga kura. Hii ni kura ya siri, kwa hivyo chaguo lako halionyeshwi kwa mtu yeyote.
Dholuo_draft: Iseyiero. Ma en yiero mopondo, omiyo yierni ok nyis ngʼato angʼata.

english: Elect your leaders and decide together. One member, one vote.
kiswahili_for_reference: Chagua viongozi wenu na muamue pamoja. Mwanachama mmoja, kura moja.
Dholuo_draft: Yieruru jotendu kendo ungʼaduru kaachiel. Jamembe achiel, yiero achiel.

english: Tap New Vote to elect a leader or put a question to the group.
kiswahili_for_reference: Gusa Kura Mpya ili kuchagua kiongozi au kuuliza kikundi swali.
Dholuo_draft: Mul Yiero Manyien mondo iyier jatelo kata iket penjo ne riwruok.

english: Voting is kept on the Intelli-Cash backend so every member sees the same tally. Connect or sign in first.
kiswahili_for_reference: Kura huhifadhiwa kwenye seva ya Intelli-Cash ili kila mwanachama aone idadi ile ile. Unganisha au ingia kwanza.
Dholuo_draft: Yiero ikano e seva mar Intelli-Cash mondo jamembe ka jamembe one kwan machalre. Tud kata idonji mokwongo.

english: The meeting opens when {officials} officials — or {members} members — each turn their key.
kiswahili_for_reference: Mkutano hufunguliwa viongozi {officials} — au wanachama {members} — wanapotumia funguo zao.
Dholuo_draft: Chokruok yawore ka jotelo {officials} — kata jomembe {members} — otiyo gi rayaw mag-gi.

english: Not finished — still needed: {fields}. Until then money still goes to the platform account.
kiswahili_for_reference: Haijakamilika — bado inahitajika: {fields}. Hadi hapo fedha bado huenda kwenye akaunti ya jukwaa.
Dholuo_draft: Pok orumo — pod dwarore: {fields}. Kapok mano pesa pod dhi e akaunt mar platform.

english: This is what gets shared out at the end of the cycle — not the total contributed. {paidOut} has been paid out so far.
kiswahili_for_reference: Hiki ndicho kitakachogawanywa mwisho wa mzunguko — si jumla iliyochangwa. {paidOut} imelipwa hadi sasa.
Dholuo_draft: Ma e gima ipogo e giko mar ndalo — ok pesa duto mane ochiw. {paidOut} osechul nyaka sani.

english: This records every payout, settles outstanding loans, and starts Cycle {cycle}. It cannot be undone.
kiswahili_for_reference: Hii hurekodi kila malipo, humaliza mikopo iliyobaki, na huanzisha Mzunguko {cycle}. Haiwezi kutenguliwa.
Dholuo_draft: Ma ndiko chudo ka chudo, chulo hola modongʼ, kendo chako Ndalo {cycle}. Ok nyal lokre.
